description: This script is a shell script designed to perform stress testing on various OpenSSL components and features. It defines functions to execute different stress tests such as BIO, DSA, TLS, cipher, ASN1, DHT, EVP, X509, EC, BN, RSA, DES, ENGINE, and ERR. The script dynamically selects test directories based on system properties, logs results, and captures system metrics during test execution. It orchestrates the entire testing process with proper delays and logging, providing a comprehensive automated stress testing framework for OpenSSL functionalities.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a given command multiple times in background, redirecting output to /dev/null.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages with timestamp and script basename to the logfile.

methods.name: stress_bio_function
methods.description: Runs various BIO stress test binaries.

methods.name: stress_cipher_function
methods.description: Runs cipher list and name test binaries.

methods.name: stress_err_function
methods.description: Runs error and fatal error test binaries.

methods.name: stress_x509_function
methods.description: Runs various X509 certificate-related test binaries.

methods.name: stress_tls_function
methods.description: Runs DTLS and TLS test binaries.

methods.name: stress_evp_function
methods.description: Runs EVP test binaries with different test data.

methods.name: stress_asn1_function
methods.description: Runs ASN.1 encoding and decoding tests.

methods.name: execute_ui_test
methods.description: Runs the UI stress test multiple times, measures time and system metrics.

methods.name: execute_bio_test
methods.description: Runs BIO stress test multiple times, measures metrics.

methods.name: execute_dsa_test
methods.description: Runs DSA stress tests and logs execution time.

methods.name: execute_tls_test
methods.description: Runs TLS stress tests with time measurement.

methods.name: execute_cipher_test
methods.description: Runs cipher list/name tests repeatedly while capturing metrics.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes testing by setting up logs, system metrics, and orchestrates all tests sequentially, logging total execution time.
